description: Team AgroDeal: Welder Barroso and Giuliano França, from Boa Vista, Roraima, Brazil. We built AgroDeal (What do I plant next?) for the Field Shift challenge: a voice and text conversation that helps small farmers in Roraima decide what to plant right after a harvest, using NASA POWER rain and soil moisture, crop traits from Embrapa and FAO ECOCROP, the official ZARC planting windows, and the goal the farmer picks. It never hides what it cannot measure.
